tokens.name: Gossip
tokens.text: Search your bag for a token of your choice.

tokens.name: Blackmail
tokens.text: Take control of another noble's movement.

tokens.name: Wits
tokens.text: Steal a token from your opponent's hand.

tokens.name: Misinformation
tokens.text: Stops draws for the round when drawn. Action to turn into chatter.

tokens.name: Chatter
tokens.text: Discard instead of returning to the bag.
